name: bugasura
description: Bug tracking and test management in Bugasura: issues, test cases, sprints, test runs, requirements, knowledge base and TestPert AI test generation.

interface.longDescription: Bugasura is a bug tracking and test management tool for software and QA teams. This plugin connects your Bugasura workspace to ChatGPT and Codex: log and update bugs, assign and comment on them; write, run and report test cases; plan sprints and test runs; manage requirements and link them to test cases; keep a project knowledge base; and generate test cases from requirements with TestPert. Refer to teams, projects and issues by name or key (such as ISS09); Bugasura resolves them for you. You sign in with your own Bugasura account, and every action runs with your permissions.
defaultPrompt: List my Bugasura teams and projects
Show the latest issues in my project
Create a test case for the login flow

positive.prompt: List my teams in Bugasura using MCP
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the reviewer's teams with their IDs and names, including My Team.

positive.description: List the projects in a team. Run in the same chat as the previous case, as in the demo recording.
positive.prompt: List my projects in My Team
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the active projects in My Team with their IDs, status and platform, including My First Project.

positive.description: List the issues in a project. Run in the same chat as the previous case, as in the demo recording.
positive.prompt: List the issues in My first project
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the issues in My First Project with their issue ID (such as MYF5), title, status, severity and priority, plus a status summary.

positive.description: Show one issue's details by its title. Run in the same chat as the previous case, as in the demo recording.
positive.prompt: Get me the details of the issue Widget doesnot displays a valid data
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the issue's ID, status, severity, priority, sprint, dates, description and environment details (device, OS, browser, resolution).

positive.description: Log a new bug. Run in the same chat as the previous case, as in the demo recording.
positive.prompt: Create an issue called - Creating issue from bugasura MCP using ChatGPT
positive.expected_behavior: Asks which sprint to file it in and lists the project's sprints. After the reply "use My First Sprint", creates the issue in My Team / My First Project with the default severity Medium and status New, and returns its issue ID.

review.commerce_description: Bugasura for ChatGPT does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release of Bugasura for ChatGPT and Codex: work with issues, test cases, sprints, test runs, requirements and the knowledge base, and generate test cases with TestPert.
